title: Song selection on Music › Songs works for Spotify likes
acceptance: At an emulated phone width (390 or narrower), the RF-151 checkboxes, 15-song cap, selection bar and "Create a class" sheet work for Spotify likes as they do for Apple Music and SoundCloud.
Ticking Spotify songs and then switching to another provider clears the selection, and switching back to Spotify starts empty.
A component or e2e test covers the Spotify likes list in pick mode with the mock provider.
nextAction: Round 1123b web Lane 1 (Neo), branch test/rf-157-spotify-likes-pick-mode: tests and this record only, no app code. A Phase-1 probe at an emulated 390 px and at 1440 with mock providers found pick mode already works for Spotify likes. Adds an e2e test (e2e/smoke.spec.ts, own instructor, both viewports) and a 15-song cap test with Spotify likes in apps/web/src/components/Dashboard.test.tsx. Restart: check out the branch, run pnpm e2e and the AGENTS.md gate.

evidence.summary: Final review of #667, item 1: RF-151 depending on RF-92 would block its Apple and SoundCloud work.

On production 67496ab (RF-151 pick mode), the Neo's desktop Chrome check in the owner's signed-in browser listed Spotify liked songs on Music › Songs and selection worked on them; nothing was saved. So Spotify likes already reach the pick-mode list; whether this record still needs work, and whether it still waits on RF-92, is for the owner to decide.

Rescope: dropped the RF-92 dependency and cut acceptance to Spotify at phone width, tick-then-switch-provider, and a mock-provider test. Owner decision "Yes rescope" was given in the Air session and relayed by the Air.

Owner Ready: in the Neo session on 2026-11-23 the conductor listed iOS RF-1237 and web RF-241 and RF-157 as the next tasks to set Ready, and the owner answered "You're approved. Let's continue completing RF tickets". The conductor recorded this as setting them Ready (RF-1237, then RF-241, then RF-157) with round 1123's method and permissions.
